core_rule: Prohibits the threat or use of force against territorial integrity or political independence
Preserves inherent right of individual or collective self-defense if an armed attack occurs
Security Council may authorize enforcement action
Connects force, non-intervention, self-determination, and territorial integrity
Lists acts that may qualify as aggression
Separates use of force, armed attack, and intervention
Emphasizes evidentiary burden, necessity, and proportionality
Addresses unlawful force, occupation, and responsibility
